codes.f: Use NUMERIC test on COMP-3 inputs before arithmetic, or initialize fields to zero. Check the dump for failing instruction (AP, ZAP, CP, etc.) and the contents of the operands.
codes.x:
01 WS-AMT PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
*> File field contained spaces -> ADD fails with S0C7.

codes.d: The program executed an instruction with an invalid operand alignment or address.
codes.a: Halfword/fullword/doubleword operand not aligned on required boundary, or odd-numbered register specified where even-odd pair is required.
codes.f: Recompile with the correct alignment options. Check OPTIMIZE level and review the failing instruction.
codes.x: L R4,DATA      *> DATA defined as CL3, not aligned on fullword boundary

codes.d: A decimal divide instruction would have produced a quotient that does not fit in the destination, or the divisor was zero.
codes.a: COMPUTE or DIVIDE statement where divisor is zero or the result is larger than the receiving field.
codes.f: Test divisor for zero before dividing; expand the receiving field's size.
codes.x:
DIVIDE A BY B GIVING C.
*> B = ZERO -> S0CB

codes.d: The system could not find the requested load module in any library on the search order.
codes.a: Module not linked, not in STEPLIB/JOBLIB/LINKLST, or wrong load library concatenation.
codes.f: Verify the load module exists with the correct name and that the JCL points to the right STEPLIB. Check link-edit JCL for the correct member name.
codes.x:
//STEPLIB DD DSN=MY.LOADLIB,DISP=SHR
*> Module MYPGM not in MY.LOADLIB -> S806

codes.d: An OPEN was issued against a data set whose name does not match what the program expects.
codes.a: DCB name in the program doesn't match the DDname on tape volumes, or the wrong tape was mounted.
codes.f: Verify the DDname and DSN. For tapes, check that the operator mounted the correct volume.
codes.x: //INFILE DD DSN=PROD.DATA  *> tape volume mismatched the DSN -> S813

codes.d: The job or step exceeded the CPU time limit specified on the JOB or EXEC card.
codes.a: Long-running loop, missing index on Db2 access, or unexpectedly large input volume.
codes.f: Increase TIME= parameter or tune the program. Add TIME=1440 for unlimited (use sparingly).
codes.x:
//STEP1 EXEC PGM=BATCH,TIME=(0,30)
*> 30 seconds CPU -> exceeded -> S322

codes.d: The number of SYSOUT records produced by the job exceeded the installation limit.
codes.a: Print loop, debug DISPLAY in production loop, or accidentally writing huge SYSOUT.
codes.f: Trim print volume. If output volume is legitimate, raise OUTLIM on the DD or job class.
codes.x:
//SYSPRINT DD SYSOUT=*,OUTLIM=10000
*> exceeded 10000 lines -> S722

codes.d: A data set requires additional space but no more secondary extents are available.
codes.a: Primary and 16 (or 123) secondary extents already allocated, or volume out of space.
codes.f: Reallocate with larger primary/secondary, or REORG to compress. Use extended-format datasets for more extents.
codes.x:
//OUTPUT DD DSN=BIG,SPACE=(CYL,(5,1))
*> file grew beyond limit -> S837

codes.d: Access to a data set or resource was denied by RACF.
codes.a: User ID lacks READ/UPDATE/ALTER access to the data set, or the data set is protected with a different profile than expected.
codes.f: Request access from the security admin, or use a generic profile that grants the needed access. Check ICH408I messages in JESYSMSG.
codes.x:
ICH408I USER(USER1) GROUP(GRP) NAME(...)
  ACCESS INTENT(UPDATE)  ACCESS ALLOWED(READ)

codes.d: Language Environment terminated the application because an unhandled condition occurred (often raised by COBOL).
codes.a: COBOL detected a condition (file status not 00, divide-by-zero, etc.) and LE was set to abend rather than continue.
codes.f: Check the CEEDUMP for the failing condition token (e.g., CEE3204 for protection). Add condition handlers or correct the underlying error.
codes.x:
CEE3204S The system detected a protection exception.
*> Original error masked by U4038 wrapper

codes.d: A program-issued ABEND with completion code 16 — commonly used as a generic 'fatal error' code.
codes.a: Application called ABEND or CEE3AB2 with code 16, usually because of a logical inconsistency the program chose to treat as fatal.
codes.f: Locate the abend invocation point in the source; check the message preceding the abend for the actual reason.
codes.x: CALL 'CEE3AB2' USING 16 BY VALUE 0 RETURNING RC.

codes.d: The data set named on a DD statement could not be found in the catalog.
codes.a: Misspelled DSN, missing catalog entry, or data set was uncataloged or deleted.
codes.f: Verify the DSN spelling and ensure the data set exists with LISTC ENT(...).
codes.x:
//INPUT DD DSN=MY.NONEXIST.FILE,DISP=SHR
IEF212I JOB1 STEP1 INPUT - DATA SET NOT FOUND

codes.d: Reports the disposition action taken on a data set at job step termination (CATALOGED, KEPT, DELETED, PASSED).
codes.a: Issued for every DD with a disposition action; informational.
codes.f: No action — for tracking only. If 'DELETED' was unexpected, check the DD's DISP for (NEW,DELETE,DELETE).
codes.x:
IEF285I  MY.OUTPUT                                  CATALOGED
IEF285I  VOL SER NOS= USR001.

codes.d: A JCL syntax or semantic error prevented the job from running.
codes.a: Misspelled keyword, missing operand, invalid value (e.g., SPACE=(CYL,-1)), or invalid data set name pattern.
codes.f: Examine the IEFCxxx messages preceding IEF453I in the job log to see the exact JCL problem.
codes.x:
IEFC630I  UNIDENTIFIED KEYWORD - SPCE
IEF453I  JOB FAILED - JCL ERROR

codes.d: A keyword on a JCL statement was supplied with an invalid value.
codes.a: Wrong syntax in DISP, SPACE, DCB, or another DD parameter; value out of allowed range.
codes.f: Refer to JCL Reference for valid syntax of the keyword.
codes.x:
//OUTPUT DD DISP=(NEW,DELETE,CATLG)
IEF642I  EXCESSIVE PARAMETER LENGTH IN THE DISP FIELD

codes.d: JES2 informational message indicating a job has been initiated.
codes.a: Job moved from input/conversion phase to execution.
codes.f: Informational only. Use as a marker that the job started executing.
codes.x: $HASP373 MYJOB    STARTED - INIT 1   - CLASS A - SYS SY01

codes.d: JES2 informational message indicating a job has completed, with its highest return code.
codes.a: Job finished — either normally or by abend.
codes.f: Read the maximum condition code or abend info shown to assess success/failure.
codes.x: $HASP395 MYJOB    ENDED - RC=0008

codes.d: JES2 has reached a resource shortage (spool, JOE, BERT, etc.).
codes.a: Spool volumes getting full, too many active jobs holding output, or BERT/JOE limits hit.
codes.f: Operator should free spool (purge old output) or operator should start more spool volumes.
codes.x: $HASP050 JES2 RESOURCE SHORTAGE OF SPOOL — 92% UTILIZATION

codes.d: JES3 detected invalid JCL during interpretation.
codes.a: Syntax errors specific to JES3 //*MAIN, //*NET, or //*PROCESS statements.
codes.f: Correct the JES3 control statement per JES3 commands reference.
codes.x:
//*MAIN CLASS=A,SYSTEM=SY01
IAT4801 INVALID OPERAND CLASS SY01

codes.d: MVS issued a symptom dump for an abnormally terminating task. Includes PSW, registers, and abend completion code.
codes.a: Any task that abended without its own ESTAE handling produces an IEA995I followed by register and PSW data.
codes.f: Read the SYSTEM COMPLETION CODE and REASON CODE in the message. Use the PSW offset to locate the failing instruction.
codes.x:
IEA995I SYMPTOM DUMP OUTPUT
  SYSTEM COMPLETION CODE=0C7  REASON CODE=00000000

codes.d: An SVC dump was taken because a SLIP trap matched.
codes.a: SLIP trap configured to capture dumps for specific abends or conditions.
codes.f: Analyze the SVC dump in IPCS using the title in the message.
codes.x:
IEA911E COMPLETE DUMP ON SYS1.DUMP00
  TITLE=SLIP DUMP FOR ABEND S0C4 - JOB MYJOB

codes.d: A console command had an invalid parameter or syntax.
codes.a: Operator typed a command with wrong syntax or invalid parameter value.
codes.f: Refer to MVS System Commands manual for correct command syntax.
codes.x:
D A,LL
IEE039I INVALID PARAMETER LL

codes.d: OPEN failed because no DD statement matches the DDname specified in the program.
codes.a: Missing DD statement in JCL, or DDname spelled differently in JCL vs. program.
codes.f: Add the matching DD statement or correct the DDname spelling.
codes.x:
IEC130I MASTER, NO DD CARD
*> Program OPENs 'MASTER' but JCL has no //MASTER DD

codes.d: OPEN failed with a 013 reason code — DCB attribute mismatch between program and data set label.
codes.a: Program DCB BLKSIZE/LRECL/RECFM doesn't match the data set's actual attributes.
codes.f: Match program's DCB attributes to those of the data set, or specify them on the DD.
codes.x:
IEC141I 013-20,IGGxxx,JOB,STEP,SYSPRINT,...,PROD.LOG
*> LRECL mismatch: PGM=80, DS=132

codes.d: OPEN failed on a VSAM data set — usually due to RACF, catalog, or status problem.
codes.a: VSAM cluster doesn't exist, is in EXCP state, password is wrong, or RACF denies access.
codes.f: Check the reason code in the message; LISTC the cluster and verify RACF access.
codes.x:
IEC161I 001(009)-009,JOB,STEP,SYSIN,VSAMCLST
*> Catalog return code 009 - cluster not found

codes.d: Open error for a non-VSAM data set. Generic open failure with a reason code.
codes.a: Various — common causes are missing dataset, wrong DCB, or device error.
codes.f: Look at the reason code in the message text.
codes.x:
IEC192I 308-04,JOB,STEP,DDIN
*> Cannot mount the requested volume

codes.d: XCF reports a sysplex membership change — system joined or left the sysplex.
codes.a: A system was IPLed, IPLed out, or partitioned out of the sysplex.
codes.f: Verify the change was expected. If unexpected partitioning, check XCF couple data sets and signaling paths.
codes.x: IXC101I SYSPLEX PARTITIONING IN PROGRESS - SYSTEM SY02 BEING REMOVED FROM SYSPLEX PLEX1

codes.d: A Coupling Facility structure encountered a problem — failure, rebuild, or connectivity issue.
codes.a: CF lost connectivity, structure full, or duplexing partner failed.
codes.f: Check CF status with D CF, review IXC messages for the structure, and rebuild if needed.
codes.x: IXC318I CONNECTIVITY TO COUPLING FACILITY CF01 LOST

codes.d: System Logger encountered an error writing or reading from a log stream.
codes.a: Log stream full, staging data set full, structure rebuild, or DASD-only logger issue.
codes.f: Check log stream definition with D LOGGER. Increase HIGHOFFLOAD threshold or expand staging.
codes.x:
IXG231I IXGCONN REQUEST FAILED FOR LOGSTREAM CICS.DFHLOG
  RETURN CODE: 00000008 REASON CODE: 0000080B

codes.d: Workload Manager rejected a policy activation request.
codes.a: Service definition has errors, missing classification rules, or service class limits violated.
codes.f: Use the WLM ISPF application to validate the service definition before activating.
codes.x:
IWM075E ACTIVATE OF POLICY PROD FAILED
  REASON: SERVICE CLASS BATCHLO REFERENCES INVALID RESOURCE

codes.d: MVS Real Storage Manager (RSM) reports auxiliary (paging) storage is critically low.
codes.a: Too few page data sets, paging data sets too small, or runaway storage user.
codes.f: Add a page data set (PA PAGE,DSN=...) immediately; identify the high pager job.
codes.x: IRA200E 70% AUXILIARY STORAGE ALLOCATED

codes.d: Real (central) storage is critically low; pageable frames in short supply.
codes.a: High working sets, runaway address space, or insufficient real storage for workload.
codes.f: Identify high storage users via D ASM,RSM. Consider adding storage or stopping low-priority work.
codes.x: IRA400E ACUTE AUXILIARY STORAGE SHORTAGE

codes.d: DFSMS could not allocate the requested data set on any candidate volume.
codes.a: Storage group out of space, no eligible volumes per ACS routines, or invalid attributes.
codes.f: Check storage group status (D SMS,SG(SGRP)) and ensure volumes are online and available.
codes.x:
IGD17103I CATALOG ERROR WHILE DEFINING VSAM DATA SET
  RETURN CODE 8 REASON CODE 42

codes.d: Automatic Restart Manager restarted an element (job, started task) after failure.
codes.a: An ARM-registered element failed and ARM policy directed a restart.
codes.f: Informational. Investigate why the original element failed.
codes.x: ARM0001I ELEMENT CICS001 RESTARTED ON SYSTEM SY02

codes.d: IDCAMS reports a non-zero return code from the catalog service. The reason code identifies the problem.
codes.a: VSAM catalog access failed — examples: data set not found (RC=8,reason=42), already exists (RC=8,reason=38), security failure (reason=4).
codes.f: Decode the reason code via Catalog Diagnosis. Common: 42 = data set not in catalog, 38 = duplicate, 84 = no space.
codes.x: IDC3009I ** VSAM CATALOG RETURN CODE IS 8 - REASON CODE IS IGG0CLEH-42

codes.t: FUNCTION COMPLETED WITH MAXIMUM CONDITION CODE
codes.d: IDCAMS reports the maximum condition code from the executed commands.
codes.a: Issued at end of each command and at job end.
codes.f: Investigate any non-zero condition codes shown.
codes.x: IDC0001I FUNCTION COMPLETED, HIGHEST CONDITION CODE WAS 0

codes.d: REPRO encountered a record with a key that already exists in the output KSDS.
codes.a: Loading a KSDS with duplicate keys, or replicating without REPLACE.
codes.f: Sort and dedupe the input, or specify REPLACE on the REPRO.
codes.x:
REPRO INFILE(IN) OUTFILE(OUT)
IDC3308I ** DUPLICATE RECORD

codes.d: Generic VSAM I/O failure reported by IDCAMS. The return code identifies the specific problem.
codes.a: Various VSAM I/O failures — physical error, structural problem, no record found.
codes.f: Decode return/reason codes via VSAM macro return codes table. Run EXAMINE on the cluster.
codes.x: IDC3014I VSAM I/O RETURN CODE IS 116 - RPLFDBWD = X'00000074'

codes.d: VSAM return code 4 — End of data reached on a sequential read.
codes.a: Read past the last record in a KSDS/ESDS/RRDS.
codes.f: Normal end-of-file condition; close the file and continue.
codes.x:
READ MY-FILE.
IF VSAM-FB-CODE = '04' AT-END....

codes.d: VSAM return code 8 (file status 22) — attempted to insert a record with a duplicate key in a UNIQUE KSDS.
codes.a: Application tried to WRITE a record whose key already exists.
codes.f: Check for duplicate via READ before WRITE, or REWRITE if updating, or change to non-unique alternate index.
codes.x:
WRITE CUST-REC.
IF CUST-STATUS = '22' DISPLAY 'DUPLICATE KEY'.

codes.d: File status 23 — READ did not find the requested record in the KSDS.
codes.a: Key value not present, or alternate index out of sync with base cluster.
codes.f: Validate the key, or rebuild the alternate index with BLDINDEX if it's stale.
codes.x:
MOVE 'X999' TO CUST-KEY.
READ CUSTOMER INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'NOT FOUND'.

codes.d: File status 92 — logic error such as opening already-open file or invalid sequence.
codes.a: Trying to READ before OPEN, REWRITE without previous READ, or OPEN on already-open file.
codes.f: Trace the application's I/O sequence; OPEN before READ; READ before REWRITE.
codes.x:
OPEN INPUT FILE-A.
OPEN INPUT FILE-A.   *> already open -> status 92

codes.d: Allocation failed because a data set with the same name already exists in the catalog.
codes.a: DISP=NEW on a DD whose DSN is already cataloged.
codes.f: Use DISP=MOD or delete the existing data set first with IDCAMS DELETE.
codes.x: IGD17040I DATA SET PROD.MY.FILE ALREADY EXISTS IN CATALOG

codes.d: SMS allocation could not find an eligible volume for the data set.
codes.a: Storage class points to a storage group whose volumes are all full or have insufficient free space.
codes.f: Add volumes, free space, or pick a different storage class.
codes.x: IGD17501I FAILED TO SELECT A VOLUME FOR DATA SET MY.NEW.FILE

codes.d: Language Environment OPEN failed for a VSAM data set under C or COBOL.
codes.a: The cluster doesn't exist, RACF denies access, or the DD has incorrect parameters.
codes.f: Verify cluster existence and access; check stdin/stdout/stderr routing in C.
codes.x: EDC5061I An error occurred when attempting to define a file to the system.

codes.d: DCB or DD attributes mismatch between the program's expectation and the data set's actual attributes.
codes.a: RECFM, LRECL, or BLKSIZE differs from the data set's label.
codes.f: Match the program's DCB to the data set, or override on the DD with DCB=(...) values.
codes.x:
IEC031I D37-04,JOB,STEP,SYSPRINT,...,'X37'
*> attempted to write more than primary, no secondary

codes.d: An output data set ran out of space and no secondary extent was specified.
codes.a: DD allocated with only primary space and the data exceeded that.
codes.f: Add secondary space: SPACE=(CYL,(10,2)). Increase primary if you can size it.
codes.x: //OUT DD DSN=BIG,SPACE=(CYL,(5))    *> no secondary -> D37

codes.d: The data set hit the maximum allowable extents (16 per volume for non-extended).
codes.a: Many small secondary extents allocated, all consumed; extended-format not used.
codes.f: Reorg/Compress the data set, or define as extended-format to allow up to 123 extents.
codes.x: IEC031I E37-04 ... data set reached 16-extent limit

codes.t: ABEND B37 — VOLUME OUT OF SPACE
codes.d: The volume holding the data set has no more space and there's no candidate volume for extension.
codes.a: Volume full; data set required additional extent but couldn't be satisfied.
codes.f: Move data set to a volume with more free space, or REORG to recover space.
codes.x: IEC031I B37-04 ... volume PRD001 has no free space

codes.d: CICS detected a program check (S0Cx-style) in an application program.
codes.a: S0C7 data exception, S0C4 protection, or other program-check condition raised during EXEC CICS RETURN.
codes.f: Read the CICS transaction dump for the actual program-check type (often S0C7) and trace it like a batch S0C7.
codes.x:
DFHAC2206 TRANSACTION TRAN ABEND ASRA AT 10:32:00
  PROGRAM=MYPGM  OFFSET=X'1234'

codes.d: A transaction exceeded the runaway task time limit and CICS terminated it.
codes.a: Tight loop in application code or large processing with no CICS service to break the loop.
codes.f: Locate the loop; add periodic EXEC CICS SUSPEND or other service to give CICS a dispatch point. Tune RUNAWAY value.
codes.x: DFHAC2206 TRAN APIN ABEND AICA — runaway 5000 ms exceeded

codes.d: EXEC CICS LINK or XCTL failed because the target program is unavailable or disabled.
codes.a: Target PROGRAM disabled in CICS, not in CSD, or not in the program load library.
codes.f: CEDA INSTALL the program definition, enable it (CEMT SET PROGRAM(...) ENABLED), or fix the load library concatenation.
codes.x:
EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('PGMB')
DFHAC2206 ... ABEND AEY9 — program disabled

codes.d: Transaction exceeded the DTIMOUT period without responding to terminal input.
codes.a: Long-running task waiting on terminal input or external resource.
codes.f: Tune DTIMOUT or restructure the task to be event-driven.
codes.x: DFHAC2206 TRAN ABEND AKCS — DTIMOUT 30 seconds exceeded

codes.d: The transaction's initial program could not be loaded.
codes.a: PROGRAM definition missing in CSD, or PROGRAM not in DFHRPL load library.
codes.f: CEDA DEFINE PROGRAM(...) GROUP(...) and CEMT NEWCOPY. Verify DFHRPL concatenation in the CICS region JCL.
codes.x: Transaction MYTR mapped to PGMA, but PGMA not in DFHRPL -> APCT.

codes.d: EXEC CICS READ/WRITE referenced a file that wasn't open or definitions disagree.
codes.a: FILE not OPEN, file disabled, or RACF blocked access.
codes.f: CEMT INQ FILE(...) and SET FILE(...) OPEN. Check FCT/CSD and access auths.
codes.x: EXEC CICS READ FILE('CUST') INTO(...)  *> CUST closed -> AEIV

codes.d: A terminal-related transaction abended because of terminal session issue.
codes.a: Terminal disconnected, VTAM session loss, or LU not bound.
codes.f: Verify VTAM status (V NET,DISPLAY,SCOPE=ALL). Reconnect terminal.
codes.x: DFHAC2003 TRAN MYTR ABEND ATCH AT 14:02 — TERMID=T001

codes.d: CICS could not open a file at startup or via CEMT.
codes.a: Underlying VSAM cluster missing, RACF denied access, or attribute mismatch.
codes.f: Verify cluster exists with LISTC; check RACF profile for CICS region userid.
codes.x: DFHFC0700 FILE CUST UNABLE TO OPEN. VSAM rc=8 reason=42

codes.d: MQGET with no-wait found no messages on the queue.
codes.a: Normal condition when polling an empty queue with MQGMO_NO_WAIT.
codes.f: If polling, this is expected. Use MQGMO_WAIT for blocking get.
codes.x:
MQGET HCONN, HOBJ, &MD, &GMO, ...
  CompCode=2 (WARNING), Reason=2033

codes.d: The connection to the queue manager was lost.
codes.a: Queue manager stopped, network failure, or channel disconnected.
codes.f: Reconnect via MQCONN. Check qmgr status with DISPLAY QMSTATUS. Review error logs for FDC files.
codes.x:
MQCMIT HCONN, ...
  CompCode=2 Reason=2009 (MQRC_CONNECTION_BROKEN)

codes.d: MQCONN failed because the queue manager is not running or not reachable.
codes.a: Queue manager not started, wrong qmgr name, or client channel definition wrong.
codes.f: Start the queue manager (strmqm), verify name, or fix MQSERVER environment / CCDT.
codes.x:
MQCONN HCONN, 'QM01', ...
  Reason=2059 - qmgr stopped

codes.d: MQ channel encountered an error and was disconnected.
codes.a: Network problem, authentication failure, or channel definition mismatch between sides.
codes.f: Check CHANNEL display, verify SSL certificates if applicable, and review the partner's logs.
codes.x: CSQX004E CHL=SVRCONN_CHL CONN failed. CompCode=2 Reason=2059

codes.d: Queue manager could not access a queue (definition error or RACF block).
codes.a: Queue does not exist, RACF block, or queue is GET-disabled/PUT-disabled.
codes.f: DISPLAY QLOCAL/QREMOTE/QALIAS for the queue; verify RACF MQ class profile.
codes.x: CSQM050E QM01 ALTER QLOCAL('Q1') failed - not authorized

codes.d: CICS Web Services / HTTP request processing failed.
codes.a: Pipeline configuration error, URIMAP not found, or remote endpoint failure.
codes.f: Check URIMAP and PIPELINE definitions; review CICS web interface trace.
codes.x: DFHWB0123 HTTP request rejected - URIMAP not found for /api/orders

codes.d: CICS task was rolled back due to a deadlock on a VSAM file or DB2 connection.
codes.a: Two transactions held conflicting locks on the same record.
codes.f: Restart the transaction; tune the application to acquire locks in consistent order.
codes.x: DFHFC4701 Transaction MYTR rolled back - deadlock on file CUST

codes.d: FTP client could not resolve the destination hostname.
codes.a: DNS resolver failure, incorrect hostname, or no /etc/resolv.conf entry.
codes.f: Verify hostname, check DNS server availability, test with PING/HOSTNAME from TSO.
codes.x:
FTP> open badhost.example.com
EZA1701 Unknown host badhost.example.com

codes.d: Standard FTP client message that a transfer or session failed.
codes.a: Various — login failure, file not found on server, permissions, network drop.
codes.f: Check preceding messages for the actual failure reason from the server.
codes.x:
EZA1735I FTP Return Code = 27000, Error Code = 00002
*> means data set not found on remote

codes.d: FTP server rejected a transfer because the requested data set does not exist.
codes.a: Wrong DSN, missing catalog entry, or HFS path incorrect.
codes.f: Verify path/DSN on the server side. Check FTP.DATA for default qualifier rules.
codes.x:
GET 'MY.NONEXIST' local.txt
EZA2899I Unknown data set MY.NONEXIST

codes.d: Communications Server reports that TCP/IP stack is initializing.
codes.a: S TCPIP start command issued.
codes.f: Informational. Wait for EZZ8061I 'INITIALIZATION COMPLETE'.
codes.x: EZZ4324I TCPIP : STACK NAME = TCPIP - VERSION 02.05.00

codes.d: A TCP/IP application could not bind to a port because it is already in use.
codes.a: Another application already listening on the port, or port reserved for a different job.
codes.f: Check the PROFILE for PORT statements; find owning application with NETSTAT BYTE.
codes.x: EZZ4356I PORT 8080 IS NOT AVAILABLE FOR USERID USER1

codes.d: Configuration file processing failed.
codes.a: Syntax error in PROFILE.TCPIP, RESOLVER.SETUP, or other config dataset.
codes.f: Re-read TCP/IP Customization Guide. Run VARY TCPIP,,SYNTAXCHECK on profile.
codes.x: EZD1166E SYNTAX ERROR IN PROFILE.TCPIP LINE 042

codes.d: VTAM cannot find a named resource (LU, APPL, line, etc.).
codes.a: Resource not defined in VTAMLST, or major node not active.
codes.f: Verify the major/minor node names; activate (V NET,ACT,ID=node) the major node.
codes.x: IST259I LU01 NOT FOUND

codes.d: VTAM could not allocate storage or a control block due to resource shortage.
codes.a: VTAM internal storage shortage; large user community or memory leak.
codes.f: Restart VTAM or grow CSA. Check D NET,STORUSE for usage.
codes.x: IST380E STORAGE LIMIT REACHED FOR VTAM

codes.d: VTAM reports an SNA sense code from a failed session or RU.
codes.a: Session activation failure, mode mismatch, or RU rejected by partner.
codes.f: Decode sense via SNA Network Programming reference (e.g., 080F0001 = no LU available).
codes.x: IST663I ACTPU REQUEST FAILED, SENSE=080F0001

codes.d: Application bind() to a socket failed.
codes.a: Port in use, RACF blocked port, or invalid address.
codes.f: Use a different port, request RACF SERVAUTH access, or check NETSTAT for owner.
codes.x: bind(): EZB1052I PORT 80 ALREADY IN USE BY OWNER1

codes.d: TCP connect() refused by the remote system.
codes.a: No listener on the port, firewall blocking, or qmgr/server down.
codes.f: Verify the server is up and listening on the expected port.
codes.x:
connect to 10.1.1.1:9080 failed
 EDC8128I Connection refused

codes.d: TCP connection abruptly reset by peer.
codes.a: Remote application crashed, firewall sent RST, or load balancer killed idle connection.
codes.f: Add retry logic; verify firewalls/timeouts; check remote logs.
codes.x: recv(): EDC8129I Connection reset by peer

codes.d: FTP server detected a configuration issue at startup.
codes.a: Bad FTP.DATA statement, missing data set, or RACF profile issue.
codes.f: Validate FTP.DATA; check FTP server SYSPRINT for full error context.
codes.x: EZZ9293I ANONYMOUS LEVEL DEFINITION INVALID

codes.d: FTP client received a server reply indicating the command was rejected.
codes.a: Permission denied, syntax error, or file does not exist on server.
codes.f: Read the 3-digit reply code (e.g., 550 = file not found) and adjust the command.
codes.x:
FTP> get /tmp/nope.txt
550 /tmp/nope.txt: No such file or directory
EZA0500 ftp: 550 reply code

codes.d: SNA sense code 0801 0000 — invalid session parameters in BIND.
codes.a: Mode entry mismatch, mode not in mode table, or session parameters not negotiable.

codes.d: Compile/link step for a staged component failed.
codes.a: Source error, missing copybook, or RACF block on output library.
codes.f: View build logs in ChangeMan; correct source and rebuild.
codes.x: CMN BLD12E COMPILE FAILED FOR COMPONENT MYPGM - RC=12

codes.d: PSF reports a printer device error.
codes.a: Printer offline, out of paper, jam, or communication failure.
codes.f: Check printer console; restart FSA after correcting at the printer.
codes.x: APS810I PRINTER PRT01 INTERVENTION REQUIRED - PAPER JAM

codes.d: PSF could not find a print resource (font, page def, form def, overlay).
codes.a: Resource library missing from FONTLIB/PSEGLIB/etc., or resource name wrong.
codes.f: Check FONT/PSEG/OVERLAY DD concatenations; verify resource exists.
codes.x: APS599I PAGE DEFINITION P1A06462 NOT FOUND IN LIBRARY

codes.d: PSF FSA (Functional Subsystem Application) initialization complete.
codes.a: S PSF or START PSFFSS issued.
codes.f: Informational. Wait for FSA ACTIVE.
codes.x: APS101I PSF FSA PRT01 ACTIVE

codes.d: PSF could not read or interpret a SYSOUT data set for printing.
codes.a: Corrupted AFP data stream, mismatched FORMDEF/PAGEDEF, or invalid AFPDS records.
codes.f: Validate output via AFP viewer; review FORMDEF/PAGEDEF for compatibility.
codes.x: APS003I DATA SET ERROR - INVALID AFPDS STRUCTURED FIELD AT OFFSET 0512

codes.d: Infoprint Server detected a configuration or processing error.
codes.a: Bad printer definition, missing transform, or invalid SAPI parameter.
codes.f: Check aopd.conf / aopxfd.conf and printer attributes via pdls.
codes.x: AOP1234E Transform PCL-to-AFP failed for job J00001

codes.d: Infoprint Server could not deliver the job.
codes.a: Destination printer offline, network down, or printer rejected the job.
codes.f: Check destination state via pdq; ensure connectivity.
codes.x: AOP020I JOB J00001 FAILED - PRINTER PRT01 NOT-RESPONDING

codes.d: Generic Infoprint Server warning — operation completed but with conditions.
codes.a: Resource substitution, font fallback, or non-critical issue.
codes.f: Review warning context; usually informational.
codes.x: AOP6789W Substituted font: Courier for missing GT12345

codes.d: PSF user abend during printer processing.
codes.a: PSF detected an unrecoverable condition (resource fault, FSI break).
codes.f: Check PSF SYSLOG; restart FSA; if recurring, contact IBM.
codes.x: PSF FSA PRT01 ABEND U0100 - FSI INTERFACE FAILURE

codes.d: IP PrintWay could not transmit a job to a network printer.
codes.a: TCP/IP connection refused, LPR error, or IPP error.
codes.f: Verify printer IP, check NETSTAT for TCP/IP state; review IP PrintWay log.
codes.x: ANFM0123E Transmission failed - target 10.1.1.50:9100 connection refused

codes.d: Job's SYSOUT output exceeded the OUTLIM limit.
codes.a: Print loop, debug DISPLAY in production loop, or unexpectedly large output.
codes.f: Trim output; raise OUTLIM if legitimately needed.
codes.x: $HASP060 JOB EXCEEDED OUTLIM 50000 LINES

codes.d: Requested font was not found; PSF substituted a similar font.
codes.a: Font CSECT not in FONTLIB, or wrong font set on FORMDEF.
codes.f: Add the font to FONTLIB or update FORMDEF to use available fonts.
codes.x: PSF: FONT X0GT15 NOT FOUND - SUBSTITUTED WITH X0GT12

codes.d: Invalid structured field in AFPDS stream.
codes.a: Application generated malformed AFP, or corrupted SYSOUT.
codes.f: Inspect the AFPDS with AFP Workbench; correct the application's emission.
codes.x: INVALID SF X'D3A8AF' AT OFFSET 02048 - LENGTH MISMATCH

codes.d: SYSOUT data set could not be closed properly.
codes.a: Spool space shortage during CLOSE, or JES2 problem.
codes.f: Resolve spool shortage; check JES2 commands.
codes.x: IEC080I JOBNAME,STEPNAME,SYSPRINT CLOSE FAILED RC=08

codes.d: PSF finished printing a job successfully.
codes.a: Normal end-of-job processing.
codes.f: Informational.
codes.x: APS010I JOB J00001 PRINTED ON PRT01 - 250 PAGES

codes.d: PSF resource generator detected an error processing a resource.
codes.a: Page seg/form def/etc. has invalid structured fields.
codes.f: Recreate the resource using current AFP tools; check version compatibility.
codes.x: APSGEN001 INVALID PAGE SEGMENT P1IMAGE1 - SF SEQUENCE INVALID

codes.d: z/OS Input/Output Supervisor detected an I/O error on a device.
codes.a: Hardware failure, missing tape mount, control unit error, or cable problem.
codes.f: Decode sense data shown; consult device vendor for the sense codes.
codes.x:
IOS000I 0900,FF,IOE,02,0E00,,**,DSN,VOLSER
  *> sense data X'FF03002B...'

codes.d: Operator must respond to a missing-interrupt condition.
codes.a: Device did not present an interrupt in expected time; usually hung tape drive or stuck DASD.
codes.f: Operator should respond, vary path offline if needed, then re-issue.
codes.x: IOS002A 0A00 MISSING INTERRUPT - REPLY N OR Y

codes.d: FICON channel performed logical recovery on a failed I/O.
codes.a: Transient channel/CU error recovered by the channel subsystem.
codes.f: Informational unless recurring. Check OPER, IECIOSxx and CU diagnostics.
codes.x: IOS050I CHANNEL RECOVERY ON CHPID 24

codes.d: z/OS detected a hardware configuration change (PR/SM, dynamic activate).
codes.a: Dynamic I/O change via HCD, or LPAR config change.
codes.f: Informational. Verify the change was expected.
codes.x: IGF11200I I/O CONFIGURATION CHANGE COMPLETE - LCU 0100 ADDED

codes.d: Hardware machine check reported by the processor.
codes.a: Recoverable or unrecoverable hardware error; PRR, repeat-instruction, etc.
codes.f: Capture LOGREC entry; report SE/HMC alert; engage IBM hardware support if recurring.
codes.x: IGF10100I MCH ICODE=00C0 PRR=01 CPU=03

codes.d: Operator must mount a specific tape volume.
codes.a: Allocation requested a non-resident tape volume.
codes.f: Operator mounts the volume on a drive; tape robot may auto-mount.
codes.x: IOS125I MOUNT TAP001 ON 0B00 FOR JOB MYJOB

codes.d: Channel subsystem could not recover the device after retries.
codes.a: Hard hardware failure or persistent connectivity loss.
codes.f: Vary device offline; engage hardware vendor.
codes.x: IOS451E DEVICE 0900 FAILED RECOVERY ATTEMPTS - VARIED OFFLINE

codes.d: z/VM CP issued a control program message (xxx is a 3-digit number).
codes.a: Various — IPL, login, logoff, device, paging events.
codes.f: Refer to z/VM CP Messages and Codes for the specific number.
codes.x: HCPCFC026E COMMAND SUSPENDED. RECONNECT TO COMPLETE.

codes.d: IBM DS8000 system reference code (SRC) indicating array event.
codes.a: Adapter card fault, rank failure, replication issue, or capacity threshold.
codes.f: Use DS GUI; reference IBM DS8000 SRC database; call IBM if hardware replacement needed.
codes.x: DS8K SRC: BE8B - RANK ARRAY MEMBER REBUILD COMPLETED

codes.d: ICKDSF utility could not initialize, refresh, or analyze a volume.
codes.a: Volume in use, wrong VOLID, or hardware issue blocking format.
codes.f: Vary volume offline before INIT; verify VOLID; check device.
codes.x: ICKDSF: INIT FAILED ON VOL000 - VOLUME IN USE

codes.d: GDPS automation detected a site or system event requiring attention.
codes.a: Cross-site PPRC issue, HyperSwap trigger, or planned freeze/swap event.
codes.f: Open GDPS operator interface; follow procedure for the alert type.
codes.x: GDPS ALERT - PPRC SUSPEND DETECTED BETWEEN SITE1 AND SITE2

codes.d: HyperSwap performed an automatic swap to the secondary mirror.
codes.a: Primary site DASD became unavailable; HyperSwap policy triggered swap.
codes.f: Verify all volumes swapped; investigate primary site failure.
codes.x: HYPERSWAP COMPLETED - 24 LSS SWAPPED FROM SITE1 TO SITE2

codes.d: Channel interface error reported by hardware.
codes.a: Physical fiber cable disconnect, SFP failure, or switch issue.
codes.f: Vary path offline; replace SFP/cable; reactivate.
codes.x: IOS150I CHPID 24 - INTERFACE ERROR (CHIT)

codes.d: PR/SM LPAR was reset or deactivated.
codes.a: Operator action, hardware fault, or activation profile change.
codes.f: Verify intent at HMC; review activation logs.
codes.x: HCPC107I LPAR PROD1 DEACTIVATED BY OPERATOR

codes.d: z/VM rejected a user logon attempt.
codes.a: Invalid userid, wrong password, or directory entry locked.
codes.f: Verify directory entry (DIRMAINT QUERY USER); reset password if needed.
codes.x: HCPLGA053E USERID NOT IN CP DIRECTORY

codes.d: Application-issued ABEND with completion code 1. Meaning depends on the application.
codes.a: Custom code path raised a fatal error: validation failure, business rule violation, or sanity check.
codes.f: Locate ABEND or CEE3AB2 call in source code; meaning is application-specific.
codes.x:
IF WS-BAD-DATA = 'Y'
   MOVE 1 TO WS-ABEND-CODE
   CALL 'CEE3AB2' USING WS-ABEND-CODE BY VALUE 0 RETURNING RC

codes.d: Generic 'fatal error' user abend code widely used as a catch-all.
codes.a: Application chose code 16 as its fatal abend value. Often issued when no specific recovery is possible.
codes.f: Look at the messages issued before the abend; they identify the actual failure.
codes.x: JOB FAILED ABEND U0016 — preceded by application's WS-MSG: 'INVALID INPUT FILE FORMAT'

codes.d: Common convention for an input-validation user abend.
codes.a: Field failed business rule (range, type, codeset).
codes.f: Inspect the input record number/key reported by the application's error log.
codes.x: Application abend U1024 with message: 'ACCOUNT FORMAT INVALID - REC 12345'

codes.d: Convention used by batch frameworks for unrecoverable processing failures.
codes.a: Framework detected unrecoverable state; commonly database update failure.
codes.f: Review framework log files; check restart procedures.
codes.x: Job abend U2000 - framework log shows DB2 -911 deadlock not retryable

codes.d: Convention used by interface programs for upstream/downstream errors.
codes.a: External system unreachable, contract violation in payload, or timeout.
codes.f: Check connectivity to external system; verify message format.
codes.x: INT-ERROR: SAP NOT RESPONDING -> ABEND U3000

codes.d: Alternative LE abend wrap commonly seen in COBOL with TERMTHDACT settings.
codes.a: LE converted an underlying condition to a user abend per runtime options.
codes.f: Run with CEEDUMP to expose the original condition token.
codes.x: Job ended with U4093 - CEEDUMP shows underlying CEE3204 (S0C4)

codes.d: Installation-written subsystem returned a non-zero condition code.
codes.a: Subsystem-specific error; meaning defined by the installation.
codes.f: Consult site documentation; check subsystem log datasets.
codes.x: Subsystem MYSS returned RC=12 - inventory file lock not released

codes.d: SAP ABAP runtime detected a database error on DB2 for z/OS.
codes.a: DB2 SQLCODE returned during SAP transaction (commonly -911 or -805).
codes.f: Check SM21 system log and ST22 dump in SAP for the SQLCODE detail.
codes.x: DBIF_RSQL_SQL_ERROR  SQLCODE -911 deadlock in transaction ZCUST

codes.d: Banking package (FIS, Fiserv, Jack Henry) reported a business-rule error.
codes.a: Account not found, invalid transaction code, or daily cutoff exceeded.
codes.f: Refer to package message guide; reverse failed transaction.
codes.x: BANK-ERR: ACCOUNT NOT FOUND FOR TRANS-CODE 200

codes.d: Insurance core system reported a policy/claim processing error.
codes.a: Policy in non-active state, missing rider, or premium calculation failure.
codes.f: Open policy in CRM; verify state and amend if needed.
codes.x: POL-ERR: RIDER R-145 MISSING ON POLICY P-123456

codes.d: Airline or hotel reservation system rejected a transaction.
codes.a: Inventory closed, PNR locked, or duplicate booking.
codes.f: Check inventory state and PNR lock holder; retry after release.
codes.x: RES-ERR: PNR LOCKED BY AGENT A1234 - cannot modify

codes.d: Externally-stored procedure abended inside DB2 (WLM stored proc address space).
codes.a: S0C7 in stored proc, SQLCODE error inside proc, or SP environment issue.
codes.f: Review WLM SP address space log; check SP source code; reapply COMPILE/BIND.
codes.x: DSNUPRC0 PROC USER1.MYPROC ABEND S0C7 IN WLM-SPAS

codes.d: An installation exit (IEFUSI, IEFACTRT, IEAVMXIT, etc.) failed.
codes.a: Exit code has a bug, or returned non-zero unexpectedly.
codes.f: Locate exit module in load library; review source; reapply after fix.
codes.x: IEFUSI exit returned RC=8 - rejected job submission

codes.d: In-house batch framework issued a controlled-failure message.
codes.a: Framework detected unrecoverable state — bad checkpoint, parm file error, etc.
codes.f: Refer to framework manual; restart per recovery procedure.
codes.x: BTCH-FW: CHECKPOINT FILE CORRUPT - run RECOVER step before retry

codes.d: MQ gateway / B2B bridge could not deliver a message.
codes.a: Format mismatch, schema validation failure, or partner endpoint down.
codes.f: Check partner queue depth; review MQ error log; validate message against schema.
codes.x: MQGW-ERR: PARTNER QM QM_PRT01 NOT REACHABLE - msg moved to BACKOUT
